changelog:
- Initial release of exa-web-search-free.
- Provides free neural web, code, and company search using Exa MCP—no API key required.
- Includes core search tools: web_search_exa, get_code_context_exa, and company_research_exa.
- Offers advanced optional tools for expanded research (people, crawling, deep search, etc.).
- Simple setup via mcporter; detailed parameters and usage examples included.
